content.short: KriptoK is a non-custodial mobile wallet for Bitcoin, Solana and EVM chains.
content.description: KriptoK is a mobile self-custody wallet spanning Bitcoin, Solana and EVM networks, with a published Halborn audit. For a wallet the audit matters more than for most software, since a key-handling bug is not something a user can notice before it costs them.
content.meta: Mobile self-custody across Bitcoin, Solana and EVM chains, with a published Halborn audit.
